title: Invertibility of the structural common-stage evaluation transpose
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$, a prime $\ell\ne D.p$, an evaluation-normalized realization family $R$, and a separated finite-type model $X$ [lem-sf-adic-qbar-constructible-realization, lem-sf-weil-native-exceptional-forgetful]. Let $Y=X\times_{D.k_0}D.k$ and let $A$ be a datum of [def-sf-weil-dual-realization-comparison-data]: in particular it specifies a normalized exceptional system $S$ for the geometric structure map, a compactification $c$, and the actual coefficient unit $\Omega$. Put $\omega=(S_c)^!\Omega$. Suppose the literal Hom pairs $(M,\omega)$ are permitted for all common-stage constructible $M$. Let $H(M)=R\mathcal Hom(M,\omega)$ be the recorded common-stage internal Hom, with the specified tensor-Hom adjunction and Koszul symmetry. For every $M$, the actual evaluation transpose $\delta_M:M\to H(H(M))$, obtained by transposing the signed-symmetry composite $M\otimes H(M)\to H(M)\otimes M\to\omega$, is an isomorphism. This is an assertion entirely in the geometric coefficient category, not about native Weil morphisms or natural transformations. In Lean the arrow is `NativeBidualRealization.commonBidual D l R X A hp M`.

source.place: Paragraph 1: underlying biduality with the exceptional dualizing object and the evaluation transpose; also sk-prop-sf-biduality-general.proof.md, final coefficient-transports paragraph.

proof.text: Apply coef_qbar_verdier to the geometric fiber and retain its internal-Hom and Dualizing witnesses. structural_dualizing_identification identifies B.omega with the specified commonOmega. Applying the existing permitted-pair Hom functor to this target isomorphism gives a natural isomorphism of Hom duals. Compose with the recorded InternalHom.comparison. Thus commonDual is an anti-equivalence, hence fully faithful.

Use full faithfulness of the realization and realizationHomIso to identify maps P to H(K) with pairings rho(P) tensor rho(K) to rho(commonOmega). The ambient tensor-Hom adjunction and its evaluation make this bijection explicit. HomLaws.naturality and HomLaws.evaluation give naturality of realized evaluation in K. HomLaws.transpose and symmetry preservation give the defining realized equation for the actual commonBidual, including its signed braiding.

For every test object P, uncurry postcomposition with commonBidual(M) and precompose with the inverse symmetry. Evaluation naturality identifies this function with f mapping to the evaluation of H(f), a composite of two bijections: full faithfulness of H and the preceding tensor-Hom bijection. Therefore postcomposition with commonBidual(M) is bijective. Apply isIso_of_yoneda_map_bijective. This proves invertibility of the specified arrow without identifying any separately chosen biduality map. The argument has no nonzero-object or nonempty-scheme assumption.

proof_origin.place: A5: the specified structural dualizing-object identification, followed by a formal Yoneda proof using full faithfulness, evaluation, tensor-Hom transposition and the signed symmetry.
